name: Huo Xin
source:
A spider working for Lao Pao.
In the Web assasin school, he is in the middle generation between Lycoris and Ding Xiu.
At the request of Zai-Jan, he was in charge of sniping when Yvet, Zhang Lei, and Roast Pork were having a three-way meeting. He also accompanied Lao Pao during the meeting between Zai-Jan and Lao Pao and threw a grenade into a police surveillance vehicle.
In the battle for Lao Pao's Fortress Mansion, he confronted Yvet on the top floor.
